messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if device falls off, call healthcare provider"
set: ["if device falls off, call healthcare provider", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "call healthcare provider if pain gets worse", "call healthcare provider if have new pain", "if light blinks red, call healthcare provider", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe", "call healthcare provider right away if hearing voices", "call healthcare provider if more sensitive to pain", "call healthcare provider if dose does not control pain", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing trouble sleeping", "stop taking if pregnant and call healthcare provider immediately", "call healthcare provider right away if new manic symptoms", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing suicidal thoughts or dying", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing attempts to harm self", "call healthcare provider or go to hospital if signs of heart problems", "call healthcare provider or Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
